photography.background_story: Use the quiet wall rhythm to keep attention on the subject.
photography.lighting: Soft side light with controlled contrast.
photography.composition: Place the subject on a third and preserve negative space.
photography.subject_intent: Keep the body relaxed and turn slightly toward the light.
photography.pose_template: Textual intent: relax the shoulders and keep the gaze just beyond the lens.
photography.camera_position: Use a slightly lower camera position at a gentle side angle.
photography.director_prompt: Confirm the background is uncluttered, then frame the subject with comfortable breathing room.
